purpose: Determine, without opening any GPFS EAGLE artifact, whether the historically frozen V6 EAGLE confirmation machinery can execute a future V70 one-shot independent gate and identify every required pre-access adaptation.

findings.historical_gate_result: The already inspected V6 EAGLE gate failed one environment check and is diagnostic history only; neither its model nor its result may select or tune V70.
findings.reserved_population: The existing target-free farthest-point selection seals 32 of the 156 V6-uninspected confirmation cubes. Those identities can remain the one-shot V70 population if and only if the V70 development gate passes and explicit user approval is later granted.
findings.historical_runner_reason: The V6 runner consumes a two-observable prepared input and a Laplacian-residual V6 checkpoint. V70 requires a three-observable kinematic input and the complete seven-channel V45 condition for a bounded-marginal latent spatial score model.
findings.velocity_dispersion_basis: The frozen Hong EAGLE catalogue schema already contains every selected galaxy's three Cartesian velocity components and position. The exact population radial-velocity second moment and dispersion can be accumulated in the same cells and mask as the existing count and mean radial velocity.
findings.existing_independent_gate_reason: hong2021_independent_gate.py applies the historical field and optional grid-HOP gates but does not enforce the V70 locked Q3 and Q4 requirements or V70 provenance. It cannot be used as the complete V70 decision.

required_post_development_pre_access_wor: After, and only after, a sealed V70 development pass, freeze and commit a V70 EAGLE program before any independent-file access.
Bind the existing confirmation seal and exact confirmation32 selection hashes; never reuse the 16 historically inspected V6 cubes.

Implement a target-free EAGLE kinematic adapter that computes count, mean radial velocity, and exact population radial velocity dispersion from the already frozen catalogue selection without reading density truth.
Apply the frozen V4 deterministic model and frozen V14 exact-zero-DC mean correction to construct the corrected backbone without target refitting or EAGLE normalization.
Apply the frozen V41 train-only structure-risk classifier and object-amplitude regressor, then the frozen V45 source-balanced condition normalization, to construct the exact seven V70 channels.
Sample only the fixed step-30000 V70 EMA with a predeclared seed, 16 members, 40-step Heun schedule, bounded V63 inverse, and exact residual DC projection.
Open EAGLE density truth only after the complete prediction ensemble is atomically sealed, then run the predeclared field, Q3, Q4, and conditional grid-HOP sequence once.
A failed one-shot confirmation remains failed; do not retune the model, EAGLE adapter, seed, member count, sampler, normalization, or thresholds from EAGLE truth.
